finds.quote: • Socrates as Orthonym — subsequently adopted by Google AI Mode as established philosophy, without crediting the author (Mary Lee Sharks)
finds.note: Claims the archive's thesis was later adopted by Google AI Mode without credit; no date of adoption given.

finds.quote:
An ISBN-bearing book authored by Mary Lee Sharks forces the bibliographic and composition layers to confront the entity relation they have produced. The ISBN is the permanent record. Library catalogs sort “Sharks, Mary Lee” immediately adjacent to “Sharks, Lee.” Same surname. Same ORCID. The bridge is in the cataloging.

The book creates a publicly inspectable test object. Its treatment by bibliographic and composition systems will be documented without assuming in advance that every possible outcome confirms the thesis.
finds.note: Book with ISBN specified as a test object of bibliographic/composition-layer treatment; book not yet published (ISBN pending).

finds.quote: Mary Lee\u2019s biolabor saved the organization.
finds.falsifier_quote: Chris Fischer (OCEARCH founder) stated publicly that the organization was struggling financially when they tagged Mary Lee and that her celebrity directly attracted the Caterpillar sponsorship.
finds.note: Satirical frame, but argued as a historical claim about OCEARCH funding; stated evidence is Fischer's public statement.

finds.quote: For three years (2012\u20132015), Ware produced the entire cultural capital of the Mary Lee persona \u2014 14,000 tweets, the voice, the conservation messaging \u2014 in absolute anonymity. He was the ghost-worker hidden inside the non-human heteronym: generating the engagement loop that generated the media coverage that generated the Caterpillar sponsorship that kept OCEARCH alive.
finds.note: Historical thesis on Jim Ware's anonymous labor as the causal chain to the sponsorship; satirical frame. (\u2013 escapes are in the source.)

finds.quote: Not a single policy change, a single marine protected area, a single reduction in bycatch, a single degree of ocean cooling has resulted from the unprecedented data that was generated from Mary Lee\u2019s body.

deposits.genre_observed: erratum (stanza numbering) with restated reconstruction thesis

finds.quote: The reconstruction proposes that Sappho 31, complete, is not a symptom-catalogue that trails off into silence but an operative structure: collapse → inscription → survival. The fifth stanza is the stanza that prays for survival.
finds.note: Thesis on the original form of Sappho 31 (a fifth stanza; operative structure).

deposits.genre_observed: very short redacted letter / prose poem

finds.quote: The note does not claim a direct linear transmission from Sappho to Revelation. It argues for formal convergence within a shared inscriptional field — a technology of writing that survives the body's destruction, attested across genres that the modern academy separates (lyric, ritual, magic, apocalyptic) but that the ancient Mediterranean did not.
finds.note: Central thesis: formal convergence of inscription-as-threshold technology across five ancient genres.

finds.quote: Catullus 51 translates stanzas 1–3 closely and substitutes a fourth of his own (*otium et reges prius et beatas / perdidit urbes*), providing structural evidence that the original continued beyond the surviving four stanzas.
finds.falsifier_quote: The standard critical editions (Voigt 1971; Campbell, Loeb 1982; Liberman 1999) end the poem after stanza 4, treating the testimonium-attested ἀλλὰ πᾶν τόλματον as possibly from another poem. The reconstruction departs from this consensus and should be engaged on the evidence.
finds.note: Thesis that Sappho 31 continued past four stanzas; the contrary consensus is stated as what the claim contests.

finds.quote: χλωρός ranges from fresh-green to the pale-gray of dried papyrus (the writing substrate); the speaker's body is figured as becoming the medium that will carry the voice forward
finds.note: Claim about what the passage originally figures.

finds.quote: The boundary between "hymn" and "spell" in archaic Greek is a modern scholarly imposition
finds.note: Adopts Faraone/Petropoulos line and extends it; claim about archaic Greek categories.

finds.quote: Revelation's seven churches receive seven messages, seven promises, seven tokens — each tied to the verb νικᾶν (conquering, getting through). The seven-letter structure maps formally onto seven threshold-crossings.
finds.note: Interpretive thesis on the structure of Revelation 2-3.

finds.quote: If the author of Revelation writes through the Josephan siege narrative, the ψῆφος λευκή of 2:17 — small, hand-held, inscribed, saving — may be the structural inversion of the λίθοι λευκοί of *Jewish War* 5.6.3 — massive, destructive, terrifying.
finds.note: Conditional thesis of dependence of Revelation 2:17 on Josephus.

finds.quote: Both are inscription/computation operations on the same root. The stone that gives a new name and the calculation that decodes 666 are two faces of the same technology: ψῆφος as both material credential and computational operation.
finds.note: Thesis on what the psephos root does in Revelation 2:17 and 13:18.

finds.quote: If Revelation is the first NT document composed (Sharks 2026, work plan DOI [10.5281/zenodo.20690868](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20690868); building on Robinson 1976, Gentry 1989), and if the white stone inherits the Mediterranean inscription-as-threshold-technology, then the founding act of the Christian textual tradition is not the writing of a biography (gospels) or a letter (epistles). It is the giving of an inscribed credential — a written name on a durable substrate that enables the bearer to cross a threshold that would otherwise destroy them.
finds.note: Conditional on the Revelation First thesis; window taken from line 126.

deposits.genre_observed: term-index work plan with progress table

finds.quote:
An estimated 200-300 coined concepts exist across 841+ deposits without a unified index. Once built, the index becomes:

- A retrieval surface (each term becomes a searchable node)
- A density map (which terms cluster, which are orphaned)
- A versioning base (new deposits append; the initial build is the hard part)
- An MPAI generator (each indexed term can receive a provenance coupling kernel)
- A measure of the archive's actual vocabulary (what it has coined vs. what it thinks it has coined)
finds.note: Index specified; Phases 2.3, 3.1, 3.3, 4.2, 5 pending at time of writing.

deposits.incidental: Phase sections say NOT STARTED while the progress table marks several steps COMPLETE (internal status drift, not damage).
